000001: // Parsing and semantic analysis, the second stage of the frontend. Two
000002: // passes over the preprocessed token stream, entered through c_parse_ast and
000003: // c_analyze_semantics at the bottom of the file (c_parse runs both):
000004: // - c_parse_ast is one linear scan that splits the stream into top-level
000005: //   CParserDeclaration records â token extents, the name token, the body
000006: //   range, and typedef/constexpr/variadic flags â by delimiter counting
000007: //   alone. It builds no tree; every later consumer re-walks token ranges.
000008: //   The same top-level/body walks validate active integer token spellings,
000009: //   including unevaluated operands, before any type-only shortcut can hide one.
000010: //   A function body is split into statements the same way, and the one fact
000011: //   kept about them is the token range of each _Static_assert statement
000012: //   (CParserStaticAssert), which c_parse_bind_function_static_asserts
000013: //   checks against the block scopes the body binder creates. Body splitting
000014: //   reuses one depth-sized CParserBodyFrames vector; published declarations
000015: //   and assertion ranges remain owned by the translation-unit arena.
000016: //   One record is one declarator, not one declaration: a comma-separated
000017: //   list is split into a record per declarator, each keeping the shared
000018: //   specifiers in token_start/token_count and its own declarator segment in
000019: //   declarator_start/declarator_count.
000020: // - c_analyze_semantics sizes its tables from a token census
000021: //   (c_parse_token_census, vectorized), then builds the CParseResult the
000022: //   lowering stage consumes: interned types, entities, scopes, and
000023: //   diagnostics.
000024: //
000025: // Types and declarators are parsed by CTypeParseMachine (types in
000026: // c_internal.h), an explicit frame stack in place of recursion: each
000027: // CTypeParseFrameKind has a c_type_parse_*_step function dispatched by
000028: // c_type_parse_machine_run. Speculative parses record every published-type
000029: // mutation (c_type_parse_record_mutation) so c_type_parse_rollback can
000030: // restore the shared type table after a failed attempt.
000031: //
000032: // Layout, in file order; each anchor is a definition to search for:
000033: //   c_parse_token_class_compute,                  keyword and token
000034: //   c_parse_position_index_build                  classification, the
000035: //                                                 matching-delimiter index
000036: //   c_parse_builtin_type_layout,                  target-dependent type
000037: //   c_parse_type_layout                           sizes/alignments, aggregate
000038: //                                                 and bit-field layout
000039: //   c_semantic_check_named_call_arities          bound call constraints without IR
000040: //   c_parse_bfloat16_builtin,                    target builtin signatures
000041: //   c_parse_validate_bfloat16_builtin_calls       checked before unused pruning
000042: //   c_parse_direct_expression_base ..             expression typing without
000043: //   c_parse_conditional_expression_type           lowering (usual arithmetic
000044: //                                                 conversions, precedence,
000045: //                                                 and the null-pointer-
000046: //                                                 constant rule a conditional
000047: //                                                 picks a pointer type with)
000048: //   c_parse_static_assert_evaluate                _Static_assert, including
000049: //                                                 deferral past unresolved
000050: //                                                 array bounds
000051: //   c_parse_initializer_designator,               initializer shapes and
000052: //   c_parse_infer_initializer_array_count_core    array-bound inference
000053: //   c_parse_add_type, c_parse_aggregate_lookup,   type interning and
000054: //   c_parse_primitive_type                        construction, attributes
000055: //   c_parse_word_bits_compute,                    specifier words answered
000056: //   c_parse_word_bits_token                       from the interned symbol
000057: //                                                 id (C_WORD_* bits), with
000058: //                                                 the spelling ladders as
000059: //                                                 the symbol-0 fallback
000060: //   c_type_parse_alignment_step ..                the type-parse machine
000061: //   c_type_parse_machine_run                      steps
000062: //   c_parse_scalar_type_core_begin,               declarators: pointers,
000063: //   c_parse_pointer_chain, c_parse_array_suffixes arrays, parameters
000064: //   c_parse_validate_constexpr_declaration,       constexpr, type
000065: //   c_parse_types_compatible                      compatibility
000066: //   c_parse_validate_cleanup_attribute            __attribute__((cleanup))
000067: //   c_parse_name_symbol .. c_parse_lookup_*       symbol interning, scopes,
000068: //                                                 entity lookup
000069: //   c_parse_local_declarations                    block-scope declarations,
000070: //                                                 auto inference, local
000071: //                                                 functions
000072: //   c_parse_label_address_prefix_proven,          statement boundaries, asm
000073: //   c_parse_statement_end                         goto, label addresses
000074: //   c_parse_bind_function_body                    binds body identifiers to
000075: //                                                 entities, indexes scopes
000076: //   c_parse_token_census_reference,               the token-shape census that
000077: //   c_parse_token_census                          sizes c_analyze_semantics'
000078: //                                                 tables: contiguous sidecar
000079: //                                                 shape compares plus a
000080: //                                                 symbol-byte projection for
000081: //                                                 the rare `for` spelling,
000082: //                                                 with the scalar reference
000083: //                                                 kept as the differential gate
000084: //   c_parse_ast, c_analyze_semantics, c_parse     the stage entry points
000085: 
000086: #include "c_internal.h"
000087: #include <buster/lib/compiler/frontend/c/c_parse_internal.h>

000089: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_declaration_keyword(String8 spelling)
000090: {
000091:     if (!c_declaration_keyword_slots_built)
000092:     {
000093:         c_declaration_keyword_slots_build();
000094:     }
000095:     u32 slot = (u32)(c_macro_name_hash(spelling) & (C_DECLARATION_KEYWORD_SLOT_COUNT - 1));
000096:     while (c_declaration_keyword_slots[slot])
000097:     {
000098:         if (string_equal(spelling, c_declaration_keyword_spellings[c_declaration_keyword_slots[slot] - 1]))
000099:         {
000100:             return true;
000101:         }
000102:         slot = (slot + 1) & (C_DECLARATION_KEYWORD_SLOT_COUNT - 1);
000103:     }
000104:     return false;
000105: }
000106: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_declaration_keyword_for_dialect(String8 spelling, CPreprocessDialect dialect)
000107: {
000108:     return c_declaration_keyword(spelling) ||
000109:            (c_preprocess_dialect_is_c23(dialect) &&
000110:              (string_equal(spelling, S8("true")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("false")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("nullptr")) ||
000111:               string_equal(spelling, S8("alignof")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("constexpr")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("typeof_unqual")))) ||
000112:            ((c_preprocess_dialect_is_gnu(dialect) || c_preprocess_dialect_is_c23(dialect)) && string_equal(spelling, S8("typeof")));
000113: }
000114: 
000115: // Spelling predicates the parser's scan loops ask per token, per scan, cached
000116: // as one class byte per token index. Token spellings are fixed once
000117: // preprocessing finishes, so the byte is computed at most once per token no
000118: // matter how many declaration scans revisit it, and speculative-parse
000119: // rollbacks cannot invalidate it.
000120: enum
000121: {
000122:     C_TOKEN_CLASS_COMPUTED = 1 << 0,
000123:     C_TOKEN_CLASS_DECLARATION_KEYWORD = 1 << 1,
000124:     C_TOKEN_CLASS_C23_EXTRA_KEYWORD = 1 << 2,
000125:     C_TOKEN_CLASS_TYPEOF = 1 << 3,
000126:     C_TOKEN_CLASS_VECTOR_SIZE = 1 << 4,
000127:     C_TOKEN_CLASS_ALIGNAS = 1 << 5,
000128: };
000129: 
000130: // Specifier-word facts stored per predefined symbol id in
000131: // CSymbolTable.word_bits, derived at table-create time from the same
000132: // spelling predicates the `_token` variants below fall back to, so the two
000133: // paths cannot drift. The qualifier bits carry which qualifier matched
000134: // because c_parse_type_qualifier_word reports its answer by setting the
000135: // matching CType flag.
000136: enum
000137: {
000138:     C_WORD_TYPE = 1 << 0,
000139:     C_WORD_AUTO_TYPE = 1 << 1,
000140:     C_WORD_TYPEOF = 1 << 2,
000141:     C_WORD_CONSTEXPR = 1 << 3,
000142:     C_WORD_TYPEOF_UNQUAL = 1 << 4,
000143:     C_WORD_QUALIFIER_CONST = 1 << 5,
000144:     C_WORD_QUALIFIER_VOLATILE = 1 << 6,
000145:     C_WORD_QUALIFIER_RESTRICT = 1 << 7,
000146:     C_WORD_QUALIFIER_ATOMIC = 1 << 8,
000147:     C_WORD_STORAGE_PREFIX = 1 << 9,
000148:     // A decoration c_parse_skip_attributes steps over ahead of a type's
000149:     // first word -- `__attribute__`, `__attribute`, `__declspec` and the asm
000150:     // label keywords -- so that "may this word start a type name" is the one
000151:     // mask test C_WORD_TYPE_NAME_START_ANY spells.
000152:     C_WORD_TYPE_NAME_DECORATION = 1 << 10,
000153: };
000154: 
000155: #define C_WORD_QUALIFIER_ANY (C_WORD_QUALIFIER_CONST | C_WORD_QUALIFIER_VOLATILE | C_WORD_QUALIFIER_RESTRICT | C_WORD_QUALIFIER_ATOMIC)
000156: 
000157: // Every word that can stand first in a type name: a type or qualifier
000158: // keyword (the tags, `_Atomic`, `__typeof__` and `_Alignas` are type words),
000159: // the dialect-gated typeof/typeof_unqual/__auto_type/constexpr spellings --
000160: // taken in every dialect, since a wrong "maybe" only costs the probe the test
000161: // exists to skip -- and the decorations.  What c_ir_type_name_prefix and
000162: // c_ir_primitive_type_kind accept begins with one of these or with an
000163: // identifier naming a typedef.
000164: #define C_WORD_TYPE_NAME_START_ANY                                                                                                       \
000165:     (C_WORD_TYPE | C_WORD_AUTO_TYPE | C_WORD_TYPEOF | C_WORD_CONSTEXPR | C_WORD_TYPEOF_UNQUAL | C_WORD_QUALIFIER_ANY | C_WORD_TYPE_NAME_DECORATION)
000166: 
000167: // The `_token` specifier predicates: same answers as their String8
000168: // counterparts, but an interned token settles on one word_bits load instead
000169: // of a spelling ladder. Symbol 0 (pasted, synthesized, or test-built tokens)
000170: // falls back to the spelling compute, so a missed path costs speed and never
000171: // correctness; a symbol above predefined_limit is a constant-time "no"
000172: // because every specifier-word spelling is interned into the predefined
000173: // range. Defined after the spelling ladders they derive from.
000174: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u16 c_parse_word_bits_token(CPreprocessResult preprocess, CToken token);
000175: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_type_word_for_dialect_token(CPreprocessResult preprocess, CToken token);
000176: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_auto_type_word_token(CPreprocessResult preprocess, CToken token);
000177: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_type_qualifier_word_token(CPreprocessResult preprocess, CToken token, CType* type);
000178: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_atomic_declaration_prefix_token(CPreprocessResult preprocess, CToken token, CType* qualifiers);
000179: 
000180: // The declaration-keyword pair answered from class_bits by symbol id; the
000181: // bits come from c_parse_token_class_compute over the same spellings, so
000182: // the id path and the spelling path cannot drift.
000183: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_declaration_keyword_token(CPreprocessResult preprocess, CToken token)
000184: {
000185:     bool result;
000186:     if (token.symbol && preprocess.symbols)
000187:     {
000188:         result = token.symbol <= preprocess.symbols->predefined_limit &&
000189:                  (preprocess.symbols->class_bits[token.symbol] & C_TOKEN_CLASS_DECLARATION_KEYWORD) != 0;
000190:     }
000191:     else
000192:     {
000193:         result = c_declaration_keyword(c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, token));
000194:     }
000195:     return result;
000196: }
000197: 
000198: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_declaration_keyword_for_dialect_token(CPreprocessResult preprocess, CToken token)
000199: {
000200:     bool result;
000201:     if (token.symbol && preprocess.symbols)
000202:     {
000203:         u8 token_class = token.symbol <= preprocess.symbols->predefined_limit ? preprocess.symbols->class_bits[token.symbol] : 0;
000204:         result = (token_class & C_TOKEN_CLASS_DECLARATION_KEYWORD) != 0 ||
000205:                  (c_preprocess_dialect_is_c23(preprocess.dialect) && (token_class & C_TOKEN_CLASS_C23_EXTRA_KEYWORD) != 0) ||
000206:                  ((c_preprocess_dialect_is_gnu(preprocess.dialect) || c_preprocess_dialect_is_c23(preprocess.dialect)) &&
000207:                   (token_class & C_TOKEN_CLASS_TYPEOF) != 0);
000208:     }
000209:     else
000210:     {
000211:         result = c_declaration_keyword_for_dialect(c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, token), preprocess.dialect);
000212:     }
000213:     return result;
000214: }

001003: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_type_is_incomplete_array(CParseResult* result, CTypeId type)
001004: {
001005:     if (!result || type.value >= result->type_count)
001006:     {
001007:         return false;
001008:     }
001009:     CType* array = result->types + type.value;
001010:     if (array->kind != C_TYPE_ARRAY || array->array_bound >= result->array_bound_count)
001011:     {
001012:         return false;
001013:     }
001014:     CArrayBound bound = result->array_bounds[array->array_bound];
001015:     return !bound.token_count && !bound.is_star && !bound.has_inferred_count;
001016: }

001018: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_type_is_flexible_array_member(CParseResult* result, CType* aggregate, u32 member_index)
001019: {
001020:     if (!result || !aggregate || aggregate->kind != C_TYPE_STRUCT || member_index + 1 != aggregate->member_count)
001021:     {
001022:         return false;
001023:     }
001024:     u32 named_member_count = 0;
001025:     for (u32 index = 0; index < aggregate->member_count; index += 1)
001026:     {
001027:         named_member_count += result->members[aggregate->member_start + index].name.length != 0;
001028:     }
001029:     CMember* member = result->members + aggregate->member_start + member_index;
001030:     if (!member->name.length || named_member_count < 2 || member->is_bit_field || !c_parse_type_is_incomplete_array(result, member->type))
001031:     {
001032:         return false;
001033:     }
001034:     CType* array = result->types + member->type.value;
001035:     return array->element_type.value < result->type_count;
001036: }
001037: 
001038: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_parse_validate_flexible_array_members(CParseResult* result, CType* aggregate)
001039: {
001040:     if (!result || !aggregate)
001041:     {
001042:         return;
001043:     }
001044:     u32 named_member_count = 0;
001045:     for (u32 member_index = 0; member_index < aggregate->member_count; member_index += 1)
001046:     {
001047:         named_member_count += result->members[aggregate->member_start + member_index].name.length != 0;
001048:     }
001049:     for (u32 member_index = 0; member_index < aggregate->member_count; member_index += 1)
001050:     {
001051:         CMember* member = result->members + aggregate->member_start + member_index;
001052:         if (!c_parse_type_is_incomplete_array(result, member->type))
001053:         {
001054:             continue;
001055:         }
001056:         String8 message = {0};
001057:         if (aggregate->kind != C_TYPE_STRUCT)
001058:         {
001059:             message = S8("flexible array member is only allowed in a structure");
001060:         }
001061:         else if (!member->name.length)
001062:         {
001063:             message = S8("flexible array member must have a name");
001064:         }
001065:         else if (member_index + 1 != aggregate->member_count)
001066:         {
001067:             message = S8("flexible array member must be the last structure member");
001068:         }
001069:         else if (named_member_count < 2)
001070:         {
001071:             message = S8("structure with a flexible array member must have another named member");
001072:         }
001073:         if (message.length)
001074:         {
001075:             c_parse_diagnostic(result, member->location, C_DIAGNOSTIC_INVALID_FLEXIBLE_ARRAY_MEMBER, message);
001076:         }
001077:     }
001078: }

001080: BUSTER_C_SHARED bool c_vector_type_layout(Target target, u64 element_size, u32 logical_byte_size, u64* element_count_out,
001081:                                           u64* storage_size_out, u32* alignment_out)
001082: {
001083:     bool valid = element_size && logical_byte_size && storage_size_out && alignment_out && logical_byte_size % element_size == 0;
001084:     u64 element_count = 0;
001085:     u64 storage_size = 0;
001086:     if (valid)
001087:     {
001088:         element_count = logical_byte_size / element_size;
001089:         storage_size = next_power_of_two(logical_byte_size);
001090:         valid = element_count && storage_size && storage_size <= UINT32_MAX / 8u;
001091:     }
001092:     if (valid)
001093:     {
001094:         if (element_count_out)
001095:         {
001096:             *element_count_out = element_count;
001097:         }
001098:         u32 alignment = (u32)storage_size;
001099:         bool padded = storage_size != logical_byte_size;
001100:         // Keep the established power-of-two vector layout unchanged. For the
001101:         // newly admitted padded GNU shape, Clang caps natural alignment at
001102:         // sixteen on AArch64. Darwin x86-64 caps it at the enabled vector
001103:         // register width; the other x86-64 ABIs retain storage alignment.
001104:         if (padded && target.cpu_arch == CPU_ARCH_AARCH64)
001105:         {
001106:             alignment = BUSTER_MIN(alignment, 16u);
001107:         }
001108:         else if (padded && target.cpu_arch == CPU_ARCH_X86_64 &&
001109:                  (target.os == OPERATING_SYSTEM_MACOS || target.os == OPERATING_SYSTEM_IOS))
001110:         {
001111:             u32 maximum = target_cpu_feature_has(target, TARGET_CPU_FEATURE_X86_AVX512F) ? 64u :
001112:                           target_cpu_feature_has(target, TARGET_CPU_FEATURE_X86_AVX) ? 32u : 16u;
001113:             alignment = BUSTER_MIN(alignment, maximum);
001114:         }
001115:         *storage_size_out = storage_size;
001116:         *alignment_out = alignment;
001117:     }
001118:     return valid;
001119: }

001121: BUSTER_C_SHARED bool c_parse_builtin_type_layout(Target target, CTypeKind kind, u64* size_out, u32* alignment_out)
001122: {
001123:     TargetDataLayout layout = target_data_layout(target);
001124:     u64 size = 0;
001125:     u32 alignment = 0;
001126:     switch (kind)
001127:     {
001128:     case C_TYPE_BOOL:
001129:         size = layout.boolean.size;
001130:         alignment = layout.boolean.alignment;
001131:         break;
001132:     case C_TYPE_CHAR:
001133:         size = layout.plain_char.size;
001134:         alignment = layout.plain_char.alignment;
001135:         break;
001136:     case C_TYPE_SIGNED_CHAR:
001137:         size = layout.signed_char.size;
001138:         alignment = layout.signed_char.alignment;
001139:         break;
001140:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR:
001141:         size = layout.unsigned_char.size;
001142:         alignment = layout.unsigned_char.alignment;
001143:         break;
001144:     case C_TYPE_SHORT:
001145:         size = layout.short_integer.size;
001146:         alignment = layout.short_integer.alignment;
001147:         break;
001148:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT:
001149:         size = layout.unsigned_short_integer.size;
001150:         alignment = layout.unsigned_short_integer.alignment;
001151:         break;
001152:     case C_TYPE_INT:
001153:         size = layout.integer.size;
001154:         alignment = layout.integer.alignment;
001155:         break;
001156:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT:
001157:         size = layout.unsigned_integer.size;
001158:         alignment = layout.unsigned_integer.alignment;
001159:         break;
001160:     case C_TYPE_FLOAT16:
001161:     case C_TYPE_BFLOAT16:
001162:     {
001163:         TargetTypeLayout narrow = kind == C_TYPE_BFLOAT16 ? layout.bfloat16_type : layout.float16_type;
001164:         size = narrow.size;
001165:         alignment = narrow.alignment;
001166:         break;
001167:     }
001168:     case C_TYPE_FLOAT:
001169:         size = layout.float_type.size;
001170:         alignment = layout.float_type.alignment;
001171:         break;
001172:     case C_TYPE_LONG:
001173:         size = layout.long_integer.size;
001174:         alignment = layout.long_integer.alignment;
001175:         break;
001176:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG:
001177:         size = layout.unsigned_long_integer.size;
001178:         alignment = layout.unsigned_long_integer.alignment;
001179:         break;
001180:     case C_TYPE_LONG_LONG:
001181:         size = layout.long_long_integer.size;
001182:         alignment = layout.long_long_integer.alignment;
001183:         break;
001184:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG:
001185:         size = layout.unsigned_long_long_integer.size;
001186:         alignment = layout.unsigned_long_long_integer.alignment;
001187:         break;
001188:     case C_TYPE_DOUBLE:
001189:         size = layout.double_type.size;
001190:         alignment = layout.double_type.alignment;
001191:         break;
001192:     case C_TYPE_NULLPTR:
001193:     case C_TYPE_POINTER:
001194:     case C_TYPE_FUNCTION:
001195:         size = layout.pointer.size;
001196:         alignment = layout.pointer.alignment;
001197:         break;
001198:     case C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE:
001199:         size = layout.long_double_type.size;
001200:         alignment = layout.long_double_type.alignment;
001201:         break;
001202:     // A complex value is two contiguous elements of its real type, so it is
001203:     // twice as wide and no more strictly aligned. Clang agrees on all three
001204:     // for every target here: sizeof/_Alignof are {8,4}, {16,8} and
001205:     // {2*sizeof(long double), _Alignof(long double)}.
001206:     case C_TYPE_FLOAT16_COMPLEX:
001207:         size = layout.float16_type.size * 2;
001208:         alignment = layout.float16_type.alignment;
001209:         break;
001210:     case C_TYPE_FLOAT_COMPLEX:
001211:         size = layout.float_type.size * 2;
001212:         alignment = layout.float_type.alignment;
001213:         break;
001214:     case C_TYPE_DOUBLE_COMPLEX:
001215:         size = layout.double_type.size * 2;
001216:         alignment = layout.double_type.alignment;
001217:         break;
001218:     case C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE_COMPLEX:
001219:         size = layout.long_double_type.size * 2;
001220:         alignment = layout.long_double_type.alignment;
001221:         break;
001222:     case C_TYPE_INT128:
001223:         size = layout.integer128.size;
001224:         alignment = layout.integer128.alignment;
001225:         break;
001226:     case C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT128:
001227:         size = layout.unsigned_integer128.size;
001228:         alignment = layout.unsigned_integer128.alignment;
001229:         break;
001230:     case C_TYPE_VA_LIST:
001231:         size = layout.va_list.size;
001232:         alignment = layout.va_list.alignment;
001233:         break;
001234:     // GNU gives `void` a size and an alignment of one so that arithmetic on a
001235:     // `void *` steps by bytes; clang and gcc both fold `sizeof(void)`,
001236:     // `sizeof(const void)` and `_Alignof(void)` to 1. It is an extension for
001237:     // that arithmetic and for `sizeof`, never a licence to declare a `void`
001238:     // object: every refusal of one keys on the *kind*, not on a zero size.
001239:     case C_TYPE_VOID:
001240:         size = 1;
001241:         alignment = 1;
001242:         break;
001243:     case C_TYPE_ARRAY:
001244:     case C_TYPE_VECTOR:
001245:     case C_TYPE_STRUCT:
001246:     case C_TYPE_UNION:
001247:     case C_TYPE_ENUM:
001248:     case C_TYPE_INVALID:
001249:     case C_TYPE_COUNT:
001250:         return false;
001251:     }
001252:     *size_out = size;
001253:     *alignment_out = alignment;
001254:     return true;
001255: }
001256: 
001257: /* The layout `_Atomic T` has, given T's own.  Clang treats `_Atomic T` as
001258:    *constructing* a type rather than qualifying one: a value it could operate on
001259:    lock-free is padded up to the next power of two and aligned there, which is
001260:    what makes `_Atomic struct { char a, b, c; }` four bytes aligned four where
001261:    the record itself is three bytes aligned one, and what gives every atomic
001262:    scalar an alignment equal to its size -- `_Atomic _Complex double` is
001263:    sixteen-byte aligned where the complex type is eight.  The ceiling is the
001264:    target's maximum lock-free width, `TargetDataLayout::atomic_max_width`: 128
001265:    bits everywhere here but wasm64 and BPF, where it is 64.  A type wider than
001266:    that keeps T's layout untouched, so the rule is not "round every aggregate
001267:    up" -- Clang leaves a seventeen-byte record seventeen bytes aligned one --
001268:    and a zero-sized aggregate still takes one byte, because an atomic operation
001269:    on it has to touch something.  GCC pads nothing and raises the alignment only
001270:    where the size is already a power of two; AGENTS.md names Clang the oracle
001271:    and the divergence is an ABI one (#731).
001272: 
001273:    Both layout engines ask here, or a folded `sizeof` contradicts the object it
001274:    measures the way `packed` and `aligned` already have the rule for:
001275:    c_parse_type_layout below applies it to every atomic type it resolves, and
001276:    c_ir_add_qualified_type in c_gen.c applies it to the copy the mapping pass
001277:    builds.  Both read the width from the *preprocess* target's data layout --
001278:    `program->data_layout` is that same record -- so the two cannot answer with
001279:    different ceilings.  An **array keeps its own layout**: `_Atomic` of one is a
001280:    constraint violation Clang and GCC both refuse, this frontend does not
001281:    diagnose it in every position, and `c_ir_add_qualified_type` refuses to build
001282:    the type at all -- so promoting here would leave the two engines answering
001283:    16 and 12 for a type neither should have built.  Both callers below that can
001284:    see one say so; the seed cannot, because no array resolves there. */
001285: BUSTER_C_SHARED void c_atomic_promoted_layout(u32 atomic_max_width, u64* size, u32* alignment)
001286: {
001287:     u64 promoted = *size ? *size : 1;
001288:     if (promoted <= atomic_max_width / 8)
001289:     {
001290:         u64 rounded = 1;
001291:         while (rounded < promoted)
001292:         {
001293:             rounded *= 2;
001294:         }
001295:         *size = rounded;
001296:         *alignment = (u32)rounded;
001297:     }
001298: }
001299: 
001300: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CTypeId c_parse_machineless_base_type(CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CScopeId scope, u32 start, u32 end,
001301:                                                           u32* index_out);
===== line 1443 =====
001323: // the aggregate back to a later pass.
001324: //
001325: // A request the alignment already satisfies is ignored rather than refused:
001326: // GNU `aligned(N)` only ever raises, so `aligned(2)` on an already 4-aligned
001327: // member is the no-op GCC and Clang make of it. A request this engine cannot
001328: // use at all -- not a power of two, or wider than a u32 -- is ignored here
001329: // too, as is a below-natural `_Alignas`, which C does forbid: the IR side
001330: // evaluates the same records, reports those by name, and lays the type out
001331: // with this same maximum, and refusing the fold here only replaced that
001332: // diagnostic with whatever a caller says when a sizeof will not fold.
001333: // `requested_out`, when asked for, receives the largest alignment any of the
001334: // records *asks* for, before it is merged with the declared type's natural
001335: // alignment. Only the bit-field placement rule needs that raw number: GNU
001336: // `aligned(N)` starts a bit-field at the next multiple of N bytes even when N
001337: // is below the declared type's own alignment, while every other reader of a
001338: // request only ever raises with it. Zero means no record resolved.
001339: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_layout_alignment_specifiers(CParseLayoutContext* context, u32 start, u32 count, u32* alignment, u32* requested_out,
001340:                                                            bool* provisional_out)
001341: {
001342:     bool valid = true;
001343:     for (u32 specifier_index = 0; specifier_index < count; specifier_index += 1)
001344:     {
001345:         if (start > context->result->alignment_count || specifier_index >= context->result->alignment_count - start)
001346:         {
001347:             valid = false;
001348:             break;
001349:         }
001350:         CAlignmentSpecifier specifier = context->result->alignments[start + specifier_index];
001351:         u64 requested_alignment = 0;
001352:         if (specifier.type.value < context->type_count)
001353:         {
001354:             if (!context->resolved[specifier.type.value])
001355:             {
001356:                 valid = false;
001357:                 break;
001358:             }
001359:             *provisional_out |= context->provisional[specifier.type.value];
001360:             requested_alignment = context->alignments[specifier.type.value];
001361:         }
001362:         else
001363:         {
001364:             u32 specifier_end = specifier.token_start + specifier.token_count;
001365:             bool alignof_type = specifier.token_count >= 4 && context->preprocess.tokens[specifier.token_start].kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER &&
001366:                                 c_parse_alignof_word(c_token_spelling(context->preprocess.spelling_base, context->preprocess.tokens[specifier.token_start])) &&
001367:                                 c_token_is_punctuator(&context->preprocess.tokens[specifier.token_start + 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS) &&
001368:                                 c_token_is_punctuator(&context->preprocess.tokens[specifier_end - 1], C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
001369:             if (alignof_type && !context->machine)
001370:             {
001371:                 valid = false;
001372:                 break;
001373:             }
001374:             if (alignof_type)
001375:             {
001376:                 u32 type_start = specifier.token_start + 2;
001377:                 u32 type_end = specifier_end - 1;
001378:                 u32 aligned_type_index = type_start;
001379:                 CTypeId aligned_type = c_parse_scalar_type(context->machine, context->result, context->preprocess, type_start, type_end, &aligned_type_index);
001380:                 if (aligned_type.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
001381:                 {
001382:                     aligned_type = c_parse_pointer_chain(context->result, context->preprocess, aligned_type, &aligned_type_index, type_end);
001383:                     aligned_type = c_parse_array_suffixes(context->result, context->preprocess, aligned_type, &aligned_type_index, type_end);
001384:                 }
001385:                 if (aligned_type.value >= context->type_count || aligned_type_index != type_end || !context->resolved[aligned_type.value])
001386:                 {
001387:                     valid = false;
001388:                     break;
001389:                 }
001390:                 *provisional_out |= context->provisional[aligned_type.value];
001391:                 requested_alignment = context->alignments[aligned_type.value];
001392:             }
001393:             else
001394:             {
001395:                 CPreprocessResult evaluation = {
001396:                     .diagnostics = arena_allocate(context->arena, CDiagnostic, specifier.token_count + 1),
001397:                     .target = context->preprocess.target,
001398:                     .dialect = context->preprocess.dialect,
001399:                 };
001400:                 if (!c_integer_expression_evaluate(context->arena, context->preprocess.spelling_base, context->preprocess.tokens + specifier.token_start, specifier.token_count, 65536, &evaluation,
001401:                                                    &requested_alignment) ||
001402:                     evaluation.diagnostic_count)
001403:                 {
001404:                     valid = false;
001405:                     break;
001406:                 }
001407:             }
001408:         }
001409:         if (requested_alignment > UINT32_MAX || (requested_alignment & (requested_alignment - 1)))
001410:         {
001411:             continue;
001412:         }
001413:         if (requested_out)
001414:         {
001415:             *requested_out = BUSTER_MAX(*requested_out, (u32)requested_alignment);
001416:         }
001417:         *alignment = BUSTER_MAX(*alignment, (u32)requested_alignment);
001418:     }
001419:     return valid;
001420: }

001422: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_type_layout(CTypeParseMachine* machine, Arena* arena, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CParseResult* result,
001423:                                              CTypeId requested, u64* size_out, u32* alignment_out)
001424: {
001425:     if (requested.value >= result->type_count)
001426:     {
001427:         return false;
001428:     }
001429:     // Almost no translation unit has an aligned typedef in it, and the two
001430:     // scans below run once per type of the table, so the empty case is one
001431:     // register test rather than a call that finds nothing.
001432:     bool any_type_alignment = result->type_alignment_count != 0;
001433:     // The seed pass below resolves builtin scalars and incomplete enums from
001434:     // the requested record alone and takes the early exit, so answer those
001435:     // without walking the table.  A type a typedef gave an alignment of its own
001436:     // is the one exception: its answer is not derivable from its kind, so it
001437:     // falls through to the solve, where the alias branch reads the request.
001438:     if (!any_type_alignment || !c_parse_type_alignment(result, requested))
001439:     {
001440:         CType requested_type = result->types[requested.value];
001441:         u64 direct_size = 0;
001442:         u32 direct_alignment = 0;
001443:         if (c_parse_builtin_type_layout(preprocess.target, requested_type.kind, &direct_size, &direct_alignment))
001444:         {
001445:             if (direct_alignment)
001446:             {
001447:                 // The same promotion the seed below performs, on the one type
001448:                 // this exit answers for; `_Atomic double` is the common shape
001449:                 // and takes it unchanged, `_Atomic _Complex float` is the one
001450:                 // that moves.
001451:                 if (requested_type.is_atomic)
001452:                 {
001453:                     c_atomic_promoted_layout(target_data_layout(preprocess.target).atomic_max_width, &direct_size, &direct_alignment);
001454:                 }
001455:                 *size_out = direct_size;
001456:                 *alignment_out = direct_alignment;
001457:                 return true;
001458:             }
001459:         }
001460:         else if (requested_type.kind == C_TYPE_ENUM && requested_type.element_type.value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
001461:         {
001462:             *size_out = 4;
001463:             *alignment_out = 4;
001464:             return true;
001465:         }
001466:     }
001467:     CTypeLayoutCache* cache = machine && preprocess.tokens && preprocess.tokens == machine->layout_cache.tokens ? &machine->layout_cache : 0;
001468:     if (cache && requested.value < cache->capacity && cache->states[requested.value])
001469:     {
001470:         *size_out = cache->sizes[requested.value];
001471:         *alignment_out = cache->alignments[requested.value];
001472:         return true;
001473:     }
001474:     // The type table can grow while the solve parses alignof/sizeof operand
001475:     // types; the scratch arrays cover the types that existed at entry and
001476:     // later additions stay unresolved for this query.
001477:     //
001478:     // The committed rows seed the scratch by copy rather than by a walk that
001479:     // reads each of them through three tests, and the three passes below
001480:     // visit the ids the cache has not committed rather than the whole table.
001481:     // The list is snapshotted here because the solve reenters the parse --
001482:     // an alignment specifier or an array bound may name a type of its own --
001483:     // and a nested query may both extend the list and move it.
001484:     u32 type_count = result->type_count;
001485:     u32* pending;
001486:     u32 pending_count;
001487:     if (cache)
001488:     {
001489:         c_type_layout_cache_reserve(cache, result->arena, type_count);
001490:         for (u32 type_index = cache->pending_seeded; type_index < type_count; type_index += 1)
001491:         {
001492:             c_type_layout_cache_pending_push(cache, type_index);
001493:         }
001494:         cache->pending_seeded = BUSTER_MAX(cache->pending_seeded, type_count);
001495:         pending_count = cache->pending_count;
001496:         pending = arena_allocate(arena, u32, pending_count + 1);
001497:         memcpy(pending, cache->pending, sizeof(*pending) * pending_count);
001498:     }
001499:     else
001500:     {
001501:         pending_count = type_count;
001502:         pending = arena_allocate(arena, u32, pending_count + 1);
001503:         for (u32 type_index = 0; type_index < type_count; type_index += 1)
001504:         {
001505:             pending[type_index] = type_index;
001506:         }
001507:     }
001508:     u64* sizes = arena_allocate(arena, u64, type_count + 1);
001509:     u32* alignments = arena_allocate(arena, u32, type_count + 1);
001510:     bool* resolved = arena_allocate(arena, bool, type_count + 1);
001511:     bool* provisional = arena_allocate(arena, bool, type_count + 1);
001512:     if (cache)
001513:     {
001514:         memcpy(sizes, cache->sizes, sizeof(*sizes) * type_count);
001515:         memcpy(alignments, cache->alignments, sizeof(*alignments) * type_count);
001516:         memcpy(resolved, cache->states, type_count);
001517:     }
001518:     else
001519:     {
001520:         memset(resolved, 0, sizeof(*resolved) * type_count);
001521:     }
001522:     memset(provisional, 0, sizeof(*provisional) * type_count);
001523:     CParseLayoutContext layout_context = {
001524:         .machine = machine,
001525:         .arena = arena,
001526:         .preprocess = preprocess,
001527:         .result = result,
001528:         .alignments = alignments,
001529:         .resolved = resolved,
001530:         .provisional = provisional,
001531:         .type_count = type_count,
001532:     };
001533:     for (u32 pending_index = 0; pending_index < pending_count; pending_index += 1)
001534:     {
001535:         u32 type_index = pending[pending_index];
001536:         if (type_index >= type_count || resolved[type_index])
001537:         {
001538:             continue;
001539:         }
001540:         CTypeKind kind = result->types[type_index].kind;
001541:         u64 size = 0;
001542:         u32 alignment = 0;
001543:         if (!c_parse_builtin_type_layout(preprocess.target, kind, &size, &alignment) && kind == C_TYPE_ENUM &&
001544:             result->types[type_index].element_type.value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
001545:         {
001546:             size = 4;
001547:             alignment = 4;
001548:             provisional[type_index] = true;
001549:         }
001550:         if (alignment)
001551:         {
001552:             // `_Atomic T` is a type built from T rather than a qualified T, so
001553:             // the copy the seed just answered from its kind takes the atomic
001554:             // layout of that kind.  The atomic branch of the solve below
001555:             // performs the same step for every kind this seed cannot answer.
001556:             if (result->types[type_index].is_atomic)
001557:             {
001558:                 c_atomic_promoted_layout(target_data_layout(preprocess.target).atomic_max_width, &size, &alignment);
001559:             }
001560:             sizes[type_index] = size;
001561:             alignments[type_index] = alignment;
001562:             resolved[type_index] = true;
001563:         }
001564:     }
001565:     // An aligned alias keeps the kind it copied, so the seed just answered it
001566:     // with the natural layout; hand those few back to the solve below, which
001567:     // owns them.  Walking the records rather than testing every type in the
001568:     // seed is what keeps the empty case -- almost every translation unit --
001569:     // free: the seed runs over the whole table on every uncached query.  A
001570:     // cached answer already carries the replacement and is left alone.
001571:     for (u32 alias_index = 0; alias_index < result->type_alignment_count; alias_index += 1)
001572:     {
001573:         u32 alias_type = result->type_alignments[alias_index].type_index;
001574:         if (alias_type < type_count && !(cache && alias_type < cache->capacity && cache->states[alias_type]))
001575:         {
001576:             resolved[alias_type] = false;
001577:         }
001578:     }
001579:     if (resolved[requested.value])
001580:     {
001581:         goto requested_resolved;
001582:     }
001583:     for (u32 pass = 0; pass < type_count; pass += 1)
001584:     {
001585:         bool progress = false;
001586:         for (u32 pending_index = 0; pending_index < pending_count; pending_index += 1)
001587:         {
001588:             u32 type_index = pending[pending_index];
001589:             if (type_index >= type_count || resolved[type_index])
001590:             {
001591:                 continue;
001592:             }
001593:             CType type = result->types[type_index];
001594:             // `typedef int cache_line __attribute__((aligned(64)))` asks for
001595:             // the alignment of a *type*, which replaces the natural one rather

002962: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CTypeId c_parse_expression_arithmetic_type(CParseResult* result, Target target, CTypeId left_id, CTypeId right_id)
002963: {
002964:     if (left_id.value >= result->type_count || right_id.value >= result->type_count)
002965:     {
002966:         return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
002967:     }
002968:     CTypeKind left = result->types[left_id.value].kind;
002969:     CTypeKind right = result->types[right_id.value].kind;
002970:     if (left == C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE || right == C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE)
002971:     {
002972:         return c_parse_expression_scalar_type(result, C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE);
002973:     }
002974:     if (left == C_TYPE_DOUBLE || right == C_TYPE_DOUBLE)
002975:     {
002976:         return c_parse_expression_scalar_type(result, C_TYPE_DOUBLE);
002977:     }
002978:     if (left == C_TYPE_FLOAT || right == C_TYPE_FLOAT)
002979:     {
002980:         return c_parse_expression_scalar_type(result, C_TYPE_FLOAT);
002981:     }
002982:     // `_Float16` ranks below every other real floating type, so it only wins
002983:     // once the three above have declined: `h * h` and `h * i` are `_Float16`,
002984:     // while `h * f` is `float`. C23 6.3.1.8p1 gives it that rank and clang
002985:     // computes the same result type.
002986:     if (left == C_TYPE_FLOAT16 || right == C_TYPE_FLOAT16 || left == C_TYPE_BFLOAT16 || right == C_TYPE_BFLOAT16)
002987:     {
002988:         return c_parse_expression_scalar_type(result, left == C_TYPE_FLOAT16 || right == C_TYPE_FLOAT16 ? C_TYPE_FLOAT16 : C_TYPE_BFLOAT16);
002989:     }
002990:     if (!c_parse_expression_integer_kind(left) || !c_parse_expression_integer_kind(right))
002991:     {
002992:         return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
002993:     }
002994:     left = c_parse_expression_promoted_kind(left);
002995:     right = c_parse_expression_promoted_kind(right);
002996:     u64 left_size = 0;
002997:     u64 right_size = 0;
002998:     u32 ignored_alignment = 0;
002999:     if (!c_parse_builtin_type_layout(target, left, &left_size, &ignored_alignment) ||
003000:         !c_parse_builtin_type_layout(target, right, &right_size, &ignored_alignment))
003001:     {
003002:         return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
003003:     }
003004:     CTypeKind result_kind = left;
003005:     bool left_signed = c_parse_expression_signed_kind(left);
003006:     bool right_signed = c_parse_expression_signed_kind(right);
003007:     if (left_signed == right_signed)
003008:     {
003009:         if (right_size > left_size || (right_size == left_size && (u32)right > (u32)left))
003010:         {
003011:             result_kind = right;
003012:         }
003013:     }
003014:     else
003015:     {
003016:         CTypeKind signed_kind = left_signed ? left : right;
003017:         CTypeKind unsigned_kind = left_signed ? right : left;
003018:         u64 signed_size = left_signed ? left_size : right_size;
003019:         u64 unsigned_size = left_signed ? right_size : left_size;
003020:         if (unsigned_size >= signed_size)
003021:         {
003022:             result_kind = unsigned_kind;
003023:         }
003024:         else
003025:         {
003026:             result_kind = signed_kind;
003027:         }
003028:         if (signed_size == unsigned_size && c_parse_expression_signed_kind(result_kind))
003029:         {
003030:             result_kind = c_parse_expression_unsigned_kind(result_kind);
003031:         }
003032:     }
003033:     return result_kind == C_TYPE_INVALID ? C_TYPE_ID_INVALID : c_parse_expression_scalar_type(result, result_kind);
003034: }

003085:     {

003089:     {
003090:         return 11;

003092:     if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS))
003093:     {
003094:         return 12;
003095:     }
003096:     if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_STAR) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_SLASH) ||
003097:         c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_PERCENT))
003098:     {
003099:         return 13;
003100:     }
003101:     return 0;

003149:                 {
003150:                     single = true;
003151:                 }
003152:                 else if (letter == 'l' || letter == 'L')
003153:                 {
003154:                     extended = true;
003155:                 }
003156:                 else if (letter == 'i' || letter == 'I' || letter == 'j' || letter == 'J')
003157:                 {
003158:                     imaginary = true;
003159:                 }
003160:                 else
003161:                 {
003162:                     break;
003163:                 }
003164:             }
003165:             kind = half ? C_TYPE_FLOAT16 : single ? C_TYPE_FLOAT : extended ? C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE : C_TYPE_DOUBLE;

002962: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CTypeId c_parse_expression_arithmetic_type(CParseResult* result, Target target, CTypeId left_id, CTypeId right_id)
002963: {
002964:     if (left_id.value >= result->type_count || right_id.value >= result->type_count)
002965:     {
002966:         return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
002967:     }
002968:     CTypeKind left = result->types[left_id.value].kind;
002969:     CTypeKind right = result->types[right_id.value].kind;
002970:     if (left == C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE || right == C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE)
002971:     {

002973:     }

002975:     {

002979:     {
002980:         return c_parse_expression_scalar_type(result, C_TYPE_FLOAT);
002981:     }
002982:     // `_Float16` ranks below every other real floating type, so it only wins
002983:     // once the three above have declined: `h * h` and `h * i` are `_Float16`,
002984:     // while `h * f` is `float`. C23 6.3.1.8p1 gives it that rank and clang
002985:     // computes the same result type.
002986:     if (left == C_TYPE_FLOAT16 || right == C_TYPE_FLOAT16 || left == C_TYPE_BFLOAT16 || right == C_TYPE_BFLOAT16)
002987:     {
002988:         return c_parse_expression_scalar_type(result, left == C_TYPE_FLOAT16 || right == C_TYPE_FLOAT16 ? C_TYPE_FLOAT16 : C_TYPE_BFLOAT16);
002989:     }
002990:     if (!c_parse_expression_integer_kind(left) || !c_parse_expression_integer_kind(right))
002991:     {
002992:         return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
002993:     }
002994:     left = c_parse_expression_promoted_kind(left);
002995:     right = c_parse_expression_promoted_kind(right);
002996:     u64 left_size = 0;
002997:     u64 right_size = 0;
002998:     u32 ignored_alignment = 0;
002999:     if (!c_parse_builtin_type_layout(target, left, &left_size, &ignored_alignment) ||
003000:         !c_parse_builtin_type_layout(target, right, &right_size, &ignored_alignment))
003001:     {
003002:         return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
003003:     }
003004:     CTypeKind result_kind = left;
003005:     bool left_signed = c_parse_expression_signed_kind(left);
003006:     bool right_signed = c_parse_expression_signed_kind(right);
003007:     if (left_signed == right_signed)
003008:     {
003009:         if (right_size > left_size || (right_size == left_size && (u32)right > (u32)left))
003010:         {
003011:             result_kind = right;
003012:         }
003013:     }
003014:     else
003015:     {
003016:         CTypeKind signed_kind = left_signed ? left : right;
003017:         CTypeKind unsigned_kind = left_signed ? right : left;
003018:         u64 signed_size = left_signed ? left_size : right_size;
003019:         u64 unsigned_size = left_signed ? right_size : left_size;
003020:         if (unsigned_size >= signed_size)
003021:         {
003022:             result_kind = unsigned_kind;
003023:         }
003024:         else
003025:         {
003026:             result_kind = signed_kind;
003027:         }
003028:         if (signed_size == unsigned_size && c_parse_expression_signed_kind(result_kind))
003029:         {
003030:             result_kind = c_parse_expression_unsigned_kind(result_kind);
003031:         }
003032:     }
003033:     return result_kind == C_TYPE_INVALID ? C_TYPE_ID_INVALID : c_parse_expression_scalar_type(result, result_kind);
003034: }

003044: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u32 c_parse_expression_operator_precedence(CToken token)
003045: {
003046:     if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_COMMA))
003047:     {
003048:         return 1;
003049:     }
003050:     if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_ASSIGN) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS_ASSIGN) ||
003051:         c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS_ASSIGN) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_STAR_ASSIGN) ||
003052:         c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_SLASH_ASSIGN) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_PERCENT_ASSIGN) ||
003053:         c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_SHIFT_LEFT_ASSIGN) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_SHIFT_RIGHT_ASSIGN) ||
003054:         c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_AMPERSAND_ASSIGN) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_CARET_ASSIGN) ||
003055:         c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_PIPE_ASSIGN))
003056:     {
003057:         return 2;
003058:     }
003059:     if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_PIPE_PIPE))
003060:     {
003061:         return 4;
003062:     }
003063:     if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_AMPERSAND_AMPERSAND))
003064:     {
003065:         return 5;
003066:     }
003067:     if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_PIPE))
003068:     {
003069:         return 6;
003070:     }
003071:     if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_CARET))
003072:     {
003073:         return 7;
003074:     }
003075:     if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_AMPERSAND))
003076:     {
003077:         return 8;
003078:     }
003079:     if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_EQUAL) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_NOT_EQUAL))
003080:     {
003081:         return 9;
003082:     }
003083:     if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LESS) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LESS_EQUAL) ||
003084:         c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_GREATER) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_GREATER_EQUAL))
003085:     {
003086:         return 10;
003087:     }
003088:     if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_SHIFT_LEFT) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_SHIFT_RIGHT))
003089:     {
003090:         return 11;
003091:     }
003092:     if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_PLUS) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS))
003093:     {
003094:         return 12;
003095:     }
003096:     if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_STAR) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_SLASH) ||
003097:         c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_PERCENT))
003098:     {
003099:         return 13;
003100:     }
003101:     return 0;
003102: }

003104: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CTypeId c_parse_expression_leaf_without_cast(Arena* arena, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CParseResult* result, CScopeId scope, u32 start,
003105:                                                                  u32 end)
003106: {
003107:     if (start >= end)
003108:     {
003109:         return C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
003110:     }
003111:     CToken first = preprocess.tokens[start];
003112:     if (first.kind == C_TOKEN_PREPROCESSING_NUMBER)
003113:     {
003114:         CTypeKind kind = C_TYPE_INT;
003115:         String8 first_spelling = c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, first);
003116:         bool hexadecimal = first_spelling.length >= 2 && first_spelling.pointer[0] == '0' && (first_spelling.pointer[1] == 'x' || first_spelling.pointer[1] == 'X');
003117:         bool floating = false;
003118:         for (u64 index = 0; index < first_spelling.length; index += 1)
003119:         {
003120:             u8 byte = first_spelling.pointer[index];
003121:             floating |= byte == '.' || byte == 'p' || byte == 'P' || (!hexadecimal && (byte == 'e' || byte == 'E'));
003122:         }
003123:         if (floating)
003124:         {
003125:             // The whole run of trailing suffix letters, not just the last
003126:             // one: GNU's imaginary `i`/`j` may sit on either side of the
003127:             // width suffix, and musl spells `_Complex_I` as `1.0fi` where
003128:             // glibc spells it `1.0iF`.
003129:             bool single = false;
003130:             bool extended = false;
003131:             bool imaginary = false;
003132:             // C23's `f16`/`F16` is the one floating suffix that is not a run
003133:             // of letters, so it is recognized before the letter scan below --
003134:             // which would otherwise stop at its `6` and read the spelling as
003135:             // an unsuffixed double. An imaginary `i`/`j` may still follow it.
003136:             u64 suffix_end = first_spelling.length;
003137:             while (suffix_end && (first_spelling.pointer[suffix_end - 1] == 'i' || first_spelling.pointer[suffix_end - 1] == 'I' ||
003138:                                   first_spelling.pointer[suffix_end - 1] == 'j' || first_spelling.pointer[suffix_end - 1] == 'J'))
003139:             {
003140:                 imaginary = true;
003141:                 suffix_end -= 1;
003142:             }
003143:             bool half = suffix_end >= 3 && (first_spelling.pointer[suffix_end - 3] == 'f' || first_spelling.pointer[suffix_end - 3] == 'F') &&
003144:                         first_spelling.pointer[suffix_end - 2] == '1' && first_spelling.pointer[suffix_end - 1] == '6';
003145:             for (u64 scan = half ? suffix_end - 3 : suffix_end; scan; scan -= 1)
003146:             {
003147:                 u8 letter = first_spelling.pointer[scan - 1];
003148:                 if (letter == 'f' || letter == 'F')
003149:                 {
003150:                     single = true;
003151:                 }
003152:                 else if (letter == 'l' || letter == 'L')
003153:                 {
003154:                     extended = true;
003155:                 }
003156:                 else if (letter == 'i' || letter == 'I' || letter == 'j' || letter == 'J')
003157:                 {
003158:                     imaginary = true;
003159:                 }
003160:                 else
003161:                 {
003162:                     break;
003163:                 }
003164:             }
003165:             kind = half ? C_TYPE_FLOAT16 : single ? C_TYPE_FLOAT : extended ? C_TYPE_LONG_DOUBLE : C_TYPE_DOUBLE;
003166:             if (imaginary)
003167:             {
003168:                 kind = c_type_kind_complex_of(kind);
003169:             }
003170:         }
003171:         else
003172:         {
003173:             bool is_unsigned = false;
003174:             u32 long_count = 0;
003175:             u32 msvc_width = c_integer_msvc_literal_width(first_spelling, &is_unsigned);
003176:             for (u64 index = first_spelling.length; !msvc_width && index != 0; index -= 1)
003177:             {
003178:                 u8 byte = first_spelling.pointer[index - 1];
003179:                 if (byte == 'u' || byte == 'U')
003180:                 {
===== line 5510 =====
005390:         {
005391:             return false;
005392:         }
005393:         CType* type = result->types + frame->type.value;
005394:         if (type->kind == C_TYPE_ARRAY)
005395:         {
005396:             designator->value_type = type->element_type;
005397:         }
005398:         else
005399:         {
005400:             CMember* member = c_parse_initializer_member_at(result, type, (u32)frame->next_index);
005401:             if (!member)
005402:             {
005403:                 return false;
005404:             }
005405:             designator->value_type = member->type;
005406:         }
005407:     }
005408:     designator->value_start = start;
005409:     designator->selected = selected;
005410:     designator->selected_end = selected_end;
005411:     designator->has_designator = false;
005412:     return true;
005413: }
005414: 
005415: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u32 c_parse_initializer_value_end(CPreprocessResult preprocess, u32 start, u32 limit)
005416: {
005417:     u32 parentheses = 0;
005418:     u32 brackets = 0;
005419:     u32 braces = 0;
005420:     for (u32 index = start; index < limit; index += 1)
005421:     {
005422:         CToken token = preprocess.tokens[index];
005423:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
005424:             parentheses += 1;
005425:         else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS))
005426:             parentheses -= parentheses != 0;
005427:         else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET))
005428:             brackets += 1;
005429:         else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACKET))
005430:             brackets -= brackets != 0;
005431:         else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE))
005432:             braces += 1;
005433:         else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACE))
005434:             braces -= braces != 0;
005435:         else if (!parentheses && !brackets && !braces && c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_COMMA))
005436:             return index;
005437:     }
005438:     return limit;
005439: }

005441: BUSTER_C_SHARED bool c_initializer_consume_separator(CToken* tokens, u32 limit, u32* cursor, u64 next_index)
005442: {
005443:     bool result;
005444:     if (!tokens || !cursor || *cursor >= limit || !c_token_is_punctuator(&tokens[*cursor], C_PUNCTUATOR_COMMA))
005445:     {
005446:         result = true;
005447:     }
005448:     else
005449:     {
005450:         *cursor += 1;
005451:         result = next_index != 0 && (*cursor >= limit || !c_token_is_punctuator(&tokens[*cursor], C_PUNCTUATOR_COMMA));
005452:     }
005453: 
005454:     return result;
005455: }

005458: {
005459:     u32 parentheses = 0;
005460:     u32 brackets = 0;
005461:     u32 braces = 0;

005466:             parentheses += 1;
005467:         else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS))
005468:             parentheses -= parentheses != 0;
005469:         else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET))
005470:             brackets += 1;
005471:         else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_BRACKET))

005473:         else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE))

005476:             braces -= braces != 0;
005477:         else if (!parentheses && !brackets && !braces && c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_COMMA))

005483: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_initializer_value_is_aggregate_expression(CTypeParseMachine* machine, Arena* arena, CPreprocessResult preprocess,
005484:                                                                            CParseResult* result, CScopeId scope, u32 start, u32 end)

005496: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_initializer_string_element_compatible(CPreprocessResult preprocess, CParseResult* result, CTypeId element_type,
005497:                                                                        CIrDecodedString decoded)
005498: {
005499:     while (element_type.value < result->type_count && result->types[element_type.value].has_unqualified_type)
005500:     {
005501:         element_type = result->types[element_type.value].unqualified_type;
005502:     }
005503:     if (element_type.value >= result->type_count)
005504:     {
005505:         return false;
005506:     }
005507:     CTypeKind kind = result->types[element_type.value].kind;
005508:     u64 size = 0;
005509:     u32 alignment = 0;
005510:     if (!c_parse_builtin_type_layout(preprocess.target, kind, &size, &alignment) || size != decoded.element_width)
005511:     {
005512:         return false;
005513:     }
005514:     if (decoded.encoding == C_IR_STRING_ENCODING_ORDINARY || decoded.encoding == C_IR_STRING_ENCODING_UTF8)
005515:     {
005516:         return decoded.element_width == 1 && (kind == C_TYPE_CHAR || kind == C_TYPE_SIGNED_CHAR || kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR);
005517:     }
005518:     return kind == decoded.element_kind;
005519: }

005521: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_infer_initializer_array_count_core(CTypeParseMachine* machine, Arena* result_arena, Arena* temporary_arena,

005524: {

005588:     while (frame_count)

013083: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_integer_expression_is_unsigned(CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CScopeId scope, u32 start, u32 end)
013084: {
013085:     for (u32 index = start; index < end; index += 1)
013086:     {
013087:         CToken token = preprocess.tokens[index];
013088:         if (token.kind == C_TOKEN_PREPROCESSING_NUMBER)
013089:         {
013090:             String8 token_spelling = c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, token);
013091:             for (u64 byte_index = 0; byte_index < token_spelling.length; byte_index += 1)
013092:             {
013093:                 char8 byte = token_spelling.pointer[byte_index];
013094:                 if (byte == 'u' || byte == 'U')
013095:                 {
013096:                     return true;
013097:                 }
013098:             }
013099:             continue;
013100:         }
013101:         if (token.kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
013102:         {
013103:             continue;
013104:         }
013105:         CEntityId entity_id = c_parse_lookup_entity_token(result, preprocess.spelling_base, scope, &token);
013106:         if (entity_id.value >= result->entity_count)
013107:         {
013108:             continue;
013109:         }
013110:         CTypeId type_id = result->entities[entity_id.value].type;
013111:         if (type_id.value >= result->type_count)
013112:         {
013113:             continue;
013114:         }
013115:         CTypeKind kind = result->types[type_id.value].kind;
013116:         if (kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_CHAR || kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_SHORT || kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT || kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG ||
013117:             kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG || kind == C_TYPE_UNSIGNED_INT128)
013118:         {
013119:             return true;
013120:         }
013121:     }
013122:     return false;
013123: }

013125: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_record_constexpr_integer(CTypeParseMachine* machine, Arena* arena, CParseResult* result,
013126:                                                           CPreprocessResult preprocess, CScopeId scope, CEntityId entity_id, u32 initializer_start,
013127:                                                           u32 initializer_end)
013128: {
013129:     if (entity_id.value >= result->entity_count)
013130:     {
013131:         return false;
013132:     }
013133:     CEntity* entity = &result->entities[entity_id.value];
013134:     if (entity->is_constexpr && entity->type.value < result->type_count)
013135:     {
013136:         CType value_type = result->types[entity->type.value];
013137:         if (c_type_kind_is_integer(value_type.kind))
013138:         {
013139:             Arena* conflicts[] = {
013140:                 arena,
013141:             };
013142:             TemporalArena temporary = scratch_begin(conflicts, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(conflicts));
013143:             u64 value = 0;
013144:             bool evaluated =
013145:                 c_parse_integer_constant_range(machine, temporary.arena, preprocess, result, scope, initializer_start, initializer_end, &value);
013146:             scratch_end(temporary);
013147:             if (!evaluated)
013148:             {
013149:                 c_parse_diagnostic(result, entity->location, C_DIAGNOSTIC_INVALID_CONSTEXPR,
013150:                                    S8("integer constexpr initializer must be an integer constant expression"));
013151:                 return false;
013152:             }
013153:             bool expression_unsigned = c_parse_integer_expression_is_unsigned(result, preprocess, scope, initializer_start, initializer_end);
013154:             bool negative = value > INT64_MAX && !expression_unsigned;
013155:             u64 magnitude = negative ? 0 - value : value;
013156:             u64 size = 0;
013157:             u32 alignment = 0;
013158:             bool representable = c_parse_builtin_type_layout(preprocess.target, value_type.kind, &size, &alignment);
013159:             BUSTER_UNUSED(alignment);
013160:             if (representable && size <= 8)
013161:             {
013162:                 u32 bits = (u32)(size * 8);
013163:                 bool target_signed = c_type_kind_is_signed_integer(value_type.kind);
013164:                 if (target_signed)
013165:                 {
013166:                     u64 positive_max = bits == 64 ? (u64)INT64_MAX : ((u64)1 << (bits - 1)) - 1;
013167:                     u64 negative_max = positive_max + 1;
013168:                     representable = negative ? magnitude <= negative_max : magnitude <= positive_max;
013169:                 }
013170:                 else
013171:                 {
013172:                     u64 maximum = value_type.kind == C_TYPE_BOOL ? 1 : bits == 64 ? UINT64_MAX : ((u64)1 << bits) - 1;
013173:                     representable = !negative && magnitude <= maximum;
013174:                 }
013175:             }
013176:             if (!representable)
013177:             {
013178:                 c_parse_diagnostic(result, entity->location, C_DIAGNOSTIC_INVALID_CONSTEXPR,
013179:                                    S8("integer constexpr initializer is not exactly representable in the declared type"));
013180:                 return false;
013181:             }
013182:             entity->has_constant_value = true;
013183:             entity->constant_is_negative = negative;
013184:             entity->constant_value = magnitude;
013185:         }
013186:     }
013187: 
013188:     return true;
013189: }

013191: BUSTER_C_SHARED bool c_parse_validate_constexpr_initializer(CTypeParseMachine* machine, Arena* arena, CParseResult* result,
013192:                                                                 CPreprocessResult preprocess, CScopeId scope, CEntityId entity_id,
013193:                                                                 u32 initializer_start, u32 initializer_end)
013194: {

013196:     {
013197:         return false;

013208:         {
013209:             return true;

013216:             {
013217:                 CToken token = preprocess.tokens[close];
013218:                 if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
013219:                 {
013220:                     depth += 1;
013221:                 }

013251:             return false;

013253:     }

013255:     return true;
